bio: The Honorable John P. (“Sean”) Coffey was confirmed by the Senate in February 2022 as the 24th General Counsel of the Navy, and served in that senior national security, four-star equivalent role until January 20, 2025. He led the Department of the Navy’s Office of General Counsel, comprised of more than 1,100 attorneys and support […]
